heading: Review Management for Marketing Teams: FAQ

questions.q: Why should marketing teams own review management?
questions.a: Reviews are a rich source of user-generated content and one of the first places new guests form an opinion of your brand. When marketing manages them, replies stay consistent in tone and can reinforce what makes your brand stand out. It also helps every location show up better in local search.

questions.q: Does responding to reviews help local SEO for multi-location businesses?
questions.a: Yes, consistently responding to reviews on your Google Business Profile signals that your brand is active and engaged. That can help each location rank better in local search. Better discoverability brings more guests to every location, online and in person.

questions.q: How should a brand respond to positive reviews?
questions.a: Thank the guest and mention specific details from their review so the reply feels personal. Use the moment to highlight what they loved, whether it's the service, a standout dish or the atmosphere. Public, thoughtful replies encourage other happy guests to share their experiences too.

questions.q: How can marketing teams manage reviews across many locations?
questions.a: Use one platform to monitor and reply to reviews for every location so tone and response times stay consistent. Avoid cookie-cutter replies by including details from each review. Pass recurring feedback to operations or local managers so they can fix the issues guests raise.
